name: Neko Para Vol.3 Neko-tachi no Aromatize
original_name: ネコぱら Vol.3 ネコたちのアロマティゼ
source:
Patisserie "La Soleil", run by Kashou Minazuki, is flourishing thanks to the help of two catgirls: Maple, full of pride and a little on the haughty side, and Cinnamon, an impulsive daydreamer.

These two are especially close among among the rest of the sisters. One day, Maple encounters something that shakes her belief in attaining her dream. Cinnamon, unwilling to see Maple suffer, wishes to help her in any way possible... but she can't figure out how. This story is a heartwarming cat comedy about their ambitions and the bonds between family members... with a little ecchi on the side, too.

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/602520/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
水无月香翔经营的糕点店“La Soleil”在两位猫女的帮助下蓬勃发展：枫，充满骄傲，有点傲慢的一面，肉桂，一个冲动的白日梦者。

在其他姐妹中，这两个人尤其亲密。有一天，梅普露遇到了一些事情，动摇了她实现梦想的信念。肉桂不愿看到枫受苦，希望尽一切可能帮助她……但她不知道如何做。这个故事是一部温馨的猫咪喜剧，讲述了它们的野心和家庭成员之间的纽带……同时也有一点点爱。

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/602520/]Steam[/url]]
